applicabilityBasis.summary: PGOLD references one troy ounce of physical gold. The sale terms describe physical-metal redemption subject to eligibility and compliance controls. Its reference quantity is gold rather than a fixed amount of national-currency monetary value, supporting non-payment-token treatment under the GENIUS definition.

references.label: GENIUS Act: payment stablecoin definition tied to fixed monetary value
Pleasing Golden Terms of Sale & Service

genius.notes: PGOLD is a gold-referenced commodity token with conditional physical-gold redemption. No GENIUS payment-stablecoin authorization posture applies. Appendix A, item 3 of the June 25, 2026 VISTO report contains the signed board resolution of Pleasing Golden International Limited expressly stating that the company issued Pleasing Gold (PGOLD), with the Arbitrum token contract matching the reviewed base record. The appendix identifies the company as incorporated in Hong Kong. This issuer attribution is a management disclosure within the assurance report; the auditor opinion concerns gold quantity at a particular date and supplies no GENIUS authorization or legal classification. The website terms name Pleasing International Limited as site operator; the report separately describes Pleasing International (HK) Limited as an affiliate. No affiliate registration or license is transferred to the PGOLD issuer.
